test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**striving**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses measures to ensure the safety of wildlife and mentions the role of public authority and local communities.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the assistance or help provided by the public authority.
 
• "**Striving**" fits well as it denotes making great efforts, which aligns with the context of preventing animals from succumbing to devastating events with the aid of public authority and local information.
 
• Other options ("**undertaking**", "**venturing**", "**trying**") do not fit the context as effectively as "striving."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.&l
